detail.longDescription: I asked 12 different AI models to build the HTML to fill its own tank at an aquarium — then displayed them for you to see and vote on your favorite one! I did this for several other "gallery" themes, such as fungi, fairy cards, bonsai trees, and constellations. Maybe not surprising, but it was interesting to see how often the models converged. Certain archetypes, such as moths or cranes in the "planetarium" gallery, appear frequently, not just in the same model family but also across model families. In the aquarium, I counted two cuttlefish, two octopuses, and two puffers (out of all of the fish in the sea!!). You might also notice particular themes or tendencies appear for certain models - for example, is it just me, or does Muse Wonder feel extremely ADHD or what? (look at the apothecary and fungarium in particular)
